name: Odette
source:
A magic school graduate who can apparently do no wrong when it comes to spells. Mira considers her a rival, but Odette feels otherwise. While not necessarily mean, she's blunt and tells it like it is. This, and the fact that she's so talented, has left her rather friendless since she comes off as stuck up.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=21471]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
